# Scan Microsoft SharePoint for secrets

@include 'beta-feature.mdx'

Connect Microsoft SharePoint as a data source to HCP Vault Radar to monitor SharePoint
sites and document libraries for sensitive data and secrets.

@include 'vault-radar/radar-quickstart-tutorials.mdx'

## Prerequisites

- HCP IAM user with the HCP owner or admin role
- Access to the Microsoft 365 tenant that contains the SharePoint data you want to scan
- Enable [admin consent
  workflow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/enterprise-apps/configure-admin-consent-workflow)
  in the Microsoft 365 tenant (if tenant-wide consent is restricted)
- Permission to register an application in [Microsoft Entra
  ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/quickstart-register-app)
  (agent scan only)
- Vault Radar agent deployed and running. Refer to the [HCP Vault Radar
  operations
  tutorials](/hcp/tutorials/hcp-vault-radar-operations/install-vault-radar-agent)
  (agent scan only)

## Add a Microsoft SharePoint data source

<Tabs>
<Tab heading="HCP Vault Radar cloud scan">

1. Log into the [HCP Portal](https://portal.cloud.hashicorp.com/sign-in) with an
   HCP IAM user that has the HCP owner or admin role.

1. Click **Vault Radar**.

1. Click **Settings**.

1. Click **Data Sources**.

1. Select **HCP Vault Radar Scan**.

1. Under **Team Collaboration**, click **Microsoft SharePoint**.
   ![Select Microsoft SharePoint data source](/img/docs/vault-radar/microsoft-sharepoint-onboarding-saas-flow.png)

1. Click **Connect to Microsoft SharePoint**. This starts the Microsoft sign-in and
   consent flow.

1. Sign in with an account of the tenant you want to scan.

1. Review the requested permissions and click **Accept**.

   <Note title="Administrator consent may be required">

   If your organization restricts tenant-wide consent, Microsoft displays a
   message that asks you to request approval from an administrator.

   </Note>

1. HCP Vault Radar displays the message **Authenticated to Microsoft SharePoint**.

1. Click **Next**.

1. Select either **All sites** or **Select sites to
   monitor**.

1. Click **Finish** to start onboarding and scanning the selected SharePoint
   sites.

</Tab>
<Tab heading="HCP Vault Radar agent scan">

@include 'vault-radar/azure-entra-setup-terraform.mdx'

1. Log into the [HCP Portal](https://portal.cloud.hashicorp.com/sign-in) with an
   HCP IAM user that has the HCP owner or admin role.

1. Click **Vault Radar**.

1. Click **Settings**.

1. Click **Data Sources**.

1. Select **HCP Vault Radar Agent Scan**.

1. Under **Team Collaboration**, click **Microsoft SharePoint**.
   ![Select Microsoft SharePoint data source](/img/docs/vault-radar/microsoft-sharepoint-onboarding-agent-flow.png)

1. Enter the following information:

   - **Microsoft Entra tenant ID:** The **Directory (tenant) ID** for the
     Microsoft Entra application.

   - **Microsoft Entra client ID:** The environment variable path where you
     stored the client ID on the agent host.

      **Example:**
   
      <CodeBlockConfig hideClipboard>
   
      ```plaintext
      env://MICROSOFT_SHAREPOINT_CLIENT_ID
      ```
   
      </CodeBlockConfig>

   - **Microsoft Entra client secret:** The environment variable path where you
     stored the client secret on the agent host.

      **Example:**
   
      <CodeBlockConfig hideClipboard>
   
      ```plaintext
      env://MICROSOFT_SHAREPOINT_CLIENT_SECRET
      ```
   
      </CodeBlockConfig>
   
1. Click **Next**.

1. Select either **All sites** or **Select sites to
   monitor**.

1. Click **Finish** to start onboarding and scanning the selected SharePoint
   sites.

</Tab>
</Tabs>
